spoken: Do this 30 minutes before bed. Dim every light you can reach. Lamps on, overhead off. Your body reads bright light as daytime. Dim light tells it the day is closing. One lamp, thirty minutes. Save this for tonight.

spoken: Sleep doesn't start in bed. It starts at the sink. Wash your face slowly, warm water, one full minute. Not for skin. As a signal: this day is done. Small ritual, easy to repeat. Follow for more quiet evening habits.

hook: Hand on belly. Breathe out slowly.
spoken: Hand on belly. Breathe out slowly. Count four in, six out. Do it five times, lying in bed. Longer exhales help the body slow down. No app, no timer, just your hand. Send this to a friend who can't switch off.

hook: Put one glass of water on your nightstand.
spoken: Put one glass of water on your nightstand. Tonight, not tomorrow. It's a cue: the evening is over and you've planned for morning. Pour it, set it down, lights low. Thirty seconds. Discipline creates freedom. Follow for more.
